motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: Press feedback for primary, secondary, and rail buttons.

motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Transform and background transitions when reduced motion is off.

components.name: Booking button
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .9rem; min-height: 48px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: .44rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--pill, 999px); color: var(--light, #fcfcfd); font: 600 1rem/1.65 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-button:active { transform: scale(.97); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-button { transition: transform 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } } .ds-button { background: var(--accent, #b94312); } .ds-button:hover { background: #9c350c; } .ds-button span { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 1.7rem; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--light, #fcfcfd); color: #8f300a; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #c9521d); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-button:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--focus, #ff9c6d); } }

components.name: Location button
components.description: Secondary clinic location link on the hero.
components.css: .ds-hero { display: inline-block; padding: .5rem; background: var(--navy, #0c2c41); } .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .9rem; min-height: 48px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: .44rem 1.15rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--pill, 999px); color: var(--light, #fcfcfd); font: 600 1rem/1.65 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-button:active { transform: scale(.97); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-button { transition: transform 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } } .ds-button { border-color: #f2f6f9ba; background: transparent; } .ds-button:hover { background: #f2f6f926; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #c9521d); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-button:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--focus, #ff9c6d); } }

components.name: Navigation disclosure
components.description: A native disclosure for navigation groups.
components.html:
Services
BiomechanicsCustom Orthotics
components.css: .ds-hero { display: inline-block; padding: .5rem; background: var(--navy, #0c2c41); } .ds-nav { font: 600 .87rem/1.65 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--light, #fcfcfd); } .ds-nav summary { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-nav summary::after { content: ""; width: .42rem; height: .42rem; margin: -.2rem 0 0 .55rem; border: solid currentColor; border-width: 0 1.5px 1.5px 0; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-nav[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(225deg); margin-top: .2rem; } .ds-dropdown { display: grid; border: 1px solid; border-radius: var(--radius, 14px); padding: .55rem; min-width: 15rem; } .ds-dropdown { background: var(--paper, #fcfcfd); color: var(--ink, #102d40); border-color: var(--line, #c6d5df); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-dropdown { background: var(--paper, #102737); color: var(--ink, #eef5f8); border-color: var(--line, #4c6779); } } .ds-dropdown a { padding: .58rem .7rem; border-radius: 8px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-dropdown a:hover { background: var(--tint, #edf3f6); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-dropdown a:hover { background: var(--tint, #173649); } } .ds-nav :is(summary, a):focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #c9521d); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-nav :is(summary, a):focus-visible { outline-color: var(--focus, #ff9c6d); } }

components.name: Service link
components.description: A compact direct link in the services list.
components.css: .ds-service-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: .4rem .85rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #c6d5df); border-radius: var(--pill, 999px); color: var(--ink, #102d40); font: 400 1rem/1.65 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-service-link { border-color: var(--line, #4c6779); color: var(--ink, #eef5f8); } } .ds-service-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: .22em; } .ds-service-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #c9521d); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-service-link:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--focus, #ff9c6d); } }

components.name: Treatment tile
components.description: The text-only treatment tile uses the same navy gradient as photo tiles.
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; align-items: end; width: min(100%, 10rem); aspect-ratio: 3/4; background: linear-gradient(0deg, #09293e 0%, transparent 85%), #20475e; border-radius: var(--radius, 14px); color: var(--light, #fcfcfd); font: 600 clamp(.75rem, 1vw, .95rem)/1.25 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tile span { padding: .75rem; } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #c9521d); outline-offset: -4px; } @media (max-width: 51rem) { .ds-tile { aspect-ratio: 4/3; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--focus, #ff9c6d); } }

components.name: Staff card
components.description: Staff card with the initials fallback and an expandable bio.
components.css: .ds-person { width: min(100%, 12rem); border: 1px solid; border-radius: var(--radius, 14px); overflow: hidden; font: 400 .91rem/1.65 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-person { background: var(--paper, #fcfcfd); color: var(--ink, #102d40); border-color: var(--line, #c6d5df); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-person { background: var(--paper, #102737); color: var(--ink, #eef5f8); border-color: var(--line, #4c6779); } } .ds-initials { display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 4/4.4; background: var(--navy, #0c2c41); color: var(--light, #fcfcfd); font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem); } .ds-person-info { padding: 1rem; } .ds-person-info h3 { margin: 0 0 .55em; font: 600 1.2rem/1.13 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.035em; } .ds-person-info summary { cursor: pointer; font-weight: 600; padding-block: .55rem; } .ds-person-info summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #c9521d); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-person-info summary:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--focus, #ff9c6d); } }

components.name: Treatment rail controls
components.description: Circular controls with an example disabled state at the start of the rail.
components.css: .ds-rail-controls { display: inline-flex; gap: .35rem; padding: .5rem; background: var(--navy, #0c2c41); } .ds-rail-controls button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border: 1px solid #ffffff6d; border-radius: 50%; background: #0c2c41b6; color: var(--light, #fcfcfd); font: 400 1rem/1.65 Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-rail-controls button:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; } .ds-rail-controls button:enabled:active { transform: scale(.97); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-rail-controls button { transition: transform 140ms ease-out, background-color 140ms ease-out; } } .ds-rail-controls button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #c9521d); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { .ds-rail-controls button:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--focus, #ff9c6d); } }

narrative.overview: The Dr Abbie family identity pairs deep clinic navy, burnt-orange booking buttons, Poppins, and photography from the clinic. The Bowral shopfront identifies the home page while adjacent treatment links help patients find the right service.
dos: Do use clinic photographs and keep the navy gradient behind white treatment labels.
Do use the orange pill for booking and keep the visible focus ring on links and controls.
